reason: The walls look tired after the monsoon, but nothing is peeling yet, and I don't repaint until I have to. ₹59,000 is close to a month's salary, and our local painter would do the flat for much less.
objection: A big brand name doesn't tell me who will actually be on my walls. If it is a subcontracted crew and something goes wrong after I've paid, will that coordinator still pick up my calls?
would_change_my_mind: If damp patches or peeling actually show up, or we have a function at home coming up, I would book the free site visit and compare their written price against my painter's.
